Treatment Planning Philosophy

Plan the whole case. Not just the next tray.

How a case is planned determines how predictable it stays. Here's the difference in approach.

Other Clear Aligner Brands

Often plan case-by-case, adjusting the approach as treatment progresses and outcomes become clearer, especially on moderate-to-complex cases.

VS
BloomAligner

Simulates and plans the full treatment arc upfront, from first tray to final retainer, before your patient's first appointment. No mid-treatment guesswork.

First in the Philippines, any clear aligner provider

BloomTrack: the only aligner progress app built for Filipino patients

Every BloomAligner patient gets free access to BloomTrack, a companion app exclusive to our provider network. No other clear aligner brand in the Philippines offers patients or dentists this level of visibility into a case, in real time.

  • Wear-time compliance tracking

    Patients log daily wear hours automatically; you see adherence per aligner stage before every check-in.

  • Automated aligner-switch reminders

    Patients get timed nudges to move to the next tray, cutting down on missed or late switches.

  • Upload a photo, send it straight to your dentist

    Patients snap a quick smile photo in-app and send it directly to their dentist for a fast check-in, no clinic visit required.
